paragraphs: I am a Full Stack Developer and I build complete web applications with React, Node.js, and Python. I like to understand the problem before implementing a solution, separate responsibilities, and care about both user experience and technical structure.
I have worked with authentication, APIs, databases, image uploads, asynchronous states, and AI integrations.
My previous work experience has also taught me to collaborate, meet deadlines, solve issues, and maintain quality in demanding environments.
about.callout: I am interested in building useful, responsive, and understandable products while taking care of the full application journey.

nutrismart.subtitle: Full Stack nutrition and training platform powered by artificial intelligence.
nutrismart.problemTitle: Tracking healthy habits often creates friction.
nutrismart.solutionTitle: Photo capture, AI, nutrition, routines, and progress in one flow.
nutrismart.architectureAria: User, React and Vite, Node.js and Express, Supabase with Auth PostgreSQL and Storage, Google Gemini, nutritional result and user
nutrismart.architectureDescription: The flow connects the React interface with a Node.js and Express API, uses Supabase for authentication, data, and storage, and delegates nutritional analysis to Google Gemini before returning the result to the user.

lac.subtitle: Web system to digitize the daily management of a dental clinic through secure authentication and clinical tools for patients and medical staff.
lac.problemTitle: Data, scheduling, and history should not live separately.
lac.solutionTitle: A system to coordinate patients, appointments, and clinical work.
lac.rolesTitle: Two experiences connected by the same database.
lac.architectureTitle: A role-protected SPA connected to Supabase.
lac.architectureAria: User, React and Vite, React Router, Context API, Supabase Auth, Supabase Database, Doctor and patient panel
lac.architectureDescription: The application separates interface, routes, authentication context, Supabase Auth, and data to deliver different panels based on the authenticated role.
lac.challengesTitle: Risks specific to a tool with roles and related data.
lac.learningsTitle: Managing a product also means organizing responsibilities.
lac.ctaTitle: A system designed to organize clinical work.

vhsflix.subtitle: Streaming-inspired platform that combines movie exploration, authentication, persistent favorites, and external API consumption.
vhsflix.problemTitle: Exploring movies requires coordinating APIs, routes, and user data.
vhsflix.solutionTitle: A streaming experience connected to a custom API.
vhsflix.featuresTitle: Real features connected across interface, API, and database.
vhsflix.architectureTitle: React frontend, Flask API, and external services connected.
vhsflix.architectureAria: User, React and Vite, React Router, Context API and useReducer, fetch services, Flask API, JWT Auth, SQLAlchemy, Render and Vercel
vhsflix.architectureDescription: The application combines a React SPA with a custom Flask API, relational data through SQLAlchemy, JWT authentication, and external services for movies, trailers, comments, and email.
vhsflix.challengesTitle: Problems specific to an app connected to APIs and user data.
vhsflix.proofTitle: Technical capabilities visible in the project.
